title: Promptcanon: tiered golden dataset lifecycle, ACLs, and regression-triggered rollback playbook
creator: Amira Soto
description: Establish a pragmatic, auditable lifecycle and stewardship model for canonical prompt + golden datasets (internally called 'Promptcanon') that ties directly to config/model change detection and automated regression responses. Deliverables: (1) dataset tiers (canary / trusted / archived) and transition rules; (2) ACL model and signer workflow for immutable snapshots; (3) automated gating: when a model or config change occurs, run prioritized evals against Promptcanon and map result changes to rollout controls (hold, canary expansion, rollback); (4) rollback playbook and runbook entries integrated with Console rollouts and Dedicated deploy policies.
acceptance_criteria: Define at least three dataset tiers and clear, machine-enforceable transition rules
Implement ACL matrix and signing workflow for immutable golden snapshots (confluence link in comments)
Regression detector triggers CI/CD gates and creates rollback tasks when quality delta > threshold
Rollout controls in Console accept Promptcanon signals to pause or rollback a model/config change
Runbook documented with owners, SLAs for triage, and a postmortem checklist
proposed_solution: Create a Promptcanon registry that stores immutable snapshot artifacts with signer metadata and a versioned fingerprint
Assign dataset tiers: Canary (small subset used for pre-release checks), Trusted (primary regression baseline), Archived (read-only historical archives)
Build an ACL layer: steward group, approver group, consumer roles; record all changes in audit log with links to PRs/Confluence

Wire regression monitor: on model/config change, run prioritized evals (canary then trusted) and compute signal -> if regression exceeds configured delta, trigger Console hold + Slack/Oncall alerts and open PM/ENG rollbacks
Provide a lightweight UI in Console for dataset stewardship tasks (promote/demote snapshots, view diffs, attach eval artifacts)
